title: Dispatch
description: One dispatch (T): a team the pilot sent out, its seats, the shape it flew in, what it returned and what was learned. The team is the unit of record. Filed by identifier in its room, T010.json.

kind.description: the word dispatch, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this dispatch's identifier, T and three digits, counted across the whole team space and the same identifier the file is named for

date.description: the day the team was dispatched, YYYY-MM-DD

session.description: the eight-character id of the session that dispatched the team

mission.description: the mission the team was flown for, M and three digits

purpose.description: what the team was sent to do, in one or two sentences

roster.description: the name of the roster the team was built from, when it was built from one

seats.description: one row per seat: its name, why it was there, and what it returned

name.description: the seat's name, matching its crew dossier

reason.description: why this seat was on the team; every seat is there for a stated reason

returns.description: what the seat actually came back with

shape.description: how the team was arranged and run, in one or two sentences

outcome.description: what the team produced and where it landed; filled in when the team finishes

lessons.description: what the next team should do differently, one line each

status.description: whether the team is still flying or has landed: dispatched, finished or abandoned
